Analise o(s) documento(s) de cenário do projeto e gere o SRS completo no formato especificado, seguindo o processo de trabalho: buscas dedicadas na base de conhecimento para cada tipo de artefato, rastreabilidade validada entre os artefatos.

Documento(s) de cenário:
--- Project Scenario 8.pdf ---
BECS (Book E-Commerce System)
So basically what we're trying to do is get books selling 
online instead of however you guys are doing it now, just a 
simple site where people can come in, look through what's 
available, throw a few books in a cart and check out. Nothing 
crazy, I just want it to actually work and not be a headache 
to keep up with. Right now I think it's all kind of manual or 
scattered and there's no real way for someone to just browse 
and buy without someone in the middle handling it, so that's 
the itch we're trying to scratch here. 
 
Anybody coming to the site should be able to just make an 
account, that's it, no big verification process or anything, 
and once they're in they can search for books and see title, 
author, price, add stuff to their cart and go through 
checkout. Keep the search simple, just matching on the title 
and it has to be exact, nothing fancy like partial matches or 
letting people search by author, that's more than we need 
right now. Some of these people might want to sign up to get 
notified about promotions and deals, so let's call those folks 
members, and they're the ones who can use promo codes when 
they check out. I picture this being pretty bare-bones in 
terms of who can buy what, like one copy of each book per 
order is plenty, we don't need people stacking ten copies of 
the same thing in their cart. 
 
On my side of things, I need a way to manage the inventory, 
basically a login that lets me add new books, edit prices, see 
how much stock I've got, that kind of stuff. I also want the 
system to ping me, like an email or something, whenever a book 
is running low so I don't get caught without stock, unless 
I've told it not to bother for that particular book because 
maybe I'm discontinuing it. And I want to be able to set up 
these percentage-off promotions every now and then and have it 
just email all the members automatically when I create one. 
 
One thing I want to be upfront about, we don't need to 
actually process real credit cards or handle real money 
movement right now, just collect the card number as part of 
the checkout flow and spit out a receipt and keep a log of 
what was purchased, who bought it, when. The real payment 
processing piece is something for way later, not part of this. 
Same with security stuff, I know that sounds bad, but honestly 
for what we need right now I'm not worried about encryption or 
people forgetting passwords or whatever, that's not a 
priority, let's not spend time building password recovery or 
anything like that for now. 
 
There's only going to be one person managing the store, me 
basically, so don't worry about building out roles for 
multiple managers or anything fancy like that, and a manager 
should never also be a regular customer account, those are two 
separate hats. It just needs to run somewhere people can get 
to it through a normal browser, nothing exotic on the 
technical side, just something stable that people in here can 
pull up and use without issues.

Sistema: BECS (Book E-Commerce System)

Resumo executivo: The BECS is a browser-based book e-commerce system that enables customers to create accounts, search for books by exact title, add books to a cart, complete checkout, receive receipts, and maintain purchase records. It also enables the store manager to manage books, prices, inventory, low-stock notifications, and percentage-off promotions. The system reduces manual intermediation and centralizes online sales operations.

Escopo: The BECS enables customers to browse and purchase books online while allowing one store manager to administer catalog, inventory, and promotions.
  Em escopo: Customer account registration
  Em escopo: Member subscription for promotional notifications
  Em escopo: Exact-title book search
  Em escopo: Book information display
  Em escopo: Shopping cart management
  Em escopo: Checkout with card-number collection
  Em escopo: Receipt generation
  Em escopo: Purchase record maintenance
  Em escopo: Manager authentication
  Em escopo: Book catalog and price management
  Em escopo: Inventory consultation
  Em escopo: Low-stock notifications
  Em escopo: Percentage-off promotion management
  Em escopo: Promotion notifications to members
  Fora de escopo: Real credit-card payment processing — explicitly deferred to a future version
  Fora de escopo: Real money movement — explicitly excluded from this version
  Fora de escopo: Password recovery — explicitly excluded from this version
  Fora de escopo: Encryption and advanced security controls — explicitly excluded from the current scope
  Fora de escopo: Multiple manager roles and permission administration — only one manager is required
  Fora de escopo: Manager and customer accounts sharing the same identity — explicitly prohibited
  Premissa: PA-01: Customers have access to a standard web browser.
  Premissa: PA-02: An email delivery capability is available for notifications. [INFERRED]
  Premissa: PA-03: The low-stock threshold for each book is configurable or defined during implementation. [TBD]
  Restrição: REST-01 (Tecnológica): The system must be accessible through a standard web browser.
  Restrição: REST-02 (Funcional): The system must collect card numbers without processing payments.
  Restrição: REST-03 (Organizacional): Only one store manager will administer the store.
  Restrição: REST-04 (Segurança): Encryption, password recovery, and advanced security controls are excluded from this version.

Stakeholders:
  STK-01 - Customer (Usuário primário): Create an account, search for books by exact title, view book information, add books to a cart, complete checkout, and receive a receipt.
  STK-02 - Member (Usuário primário): Receive promotion notifications and use promotional codes during checkout.
  STK-03 - Store Manager (Usuário primário): Log in separately from customer accounts, manage books and prices, inspect inventory, configure low-stock notifications, and create promotions.
  STK-04 - Email Delivery Service (Stakeholder externo): Receive notification requests and deliver low-stock and promotion messages.

Regras de negócio:
  RN-001 - Exact-title search: A book search matches only the complete book title; partial-title and author-based searches are not supported.
  RN-002 - Maximum quantity per book: An order may contain no more than one copy of each distinct book.
  RN-003 - Promotion eligibility: Only members may apply promotional codes during checkout.
  RN-004 - Promotion discount type: Store promotions apply a percentage discount to eligible purchases.
  RN-005 - Low-stock notification suppression: A low-stock notification must be sent when a book reaches its low-stock condition unless notification suppression has been configured for that book.
  RN-006 - Account separation: A manager account and a regular customer account represent separate account types and may not be used as the same account.

Requisitos funcionais:
  RF-001 - Customer account registration: The system must register a customer account using the information required by the registration form. [Must have]
  RF-002 - Member subscription: The system must register a customer as a member when the customer subscribes to promotional notifications. [Should have]
  RF-003 - Exact-title book search: The system must search for books using the complete title entered by the customer. [Must have]
  RF-004 - Book information display: The system must display the title, author, and price of a selected book. [Must have]
  RF-005 - Add book to cart: The system must add a selected book to the customer's shopping cart. [Must have]
  RF-006 - Cart quantity enforcement: The system must prevent more than one copy of the same book from being included in an order. [Must have]
  RF-007 - Checkout card collection: The system must collect the card number entered during checkout without submitting it to a payment processor. [Must have]
  RF-008 - Promotion code application: The system must apply a valid promotional code to a checkout performed by a member. [Should have]
  RF-009 - Receipt generation: The system must generate a receipt after checkout completion. [Must have]
  RF-010 - Purchase record creation: The system must record the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date after checkout completion. [Must have]
  RF-011 - Manager authentication: The system must authenticate the store manager through a manager account. [Must have]
  RF-012 - Book creation: The system must allow the store manager to add a new book to the catalog. [Must have]
  RF-013 - Book price editing: The system must allow the store manager to edit the price of a cataloged book. [Must have]
  RF-014 - Inventory consultation: The system must display the current stock quantity for each cataloged book to the store manager. [Must have]
  RF-015 - Low-stock notification: The system must send a notification to the store manager when a book reaches its configured low-stock condition. [Should have]
  RF-016 - Low-stock notification suppression: The system must allow the store manager to suppress low-stock notifications for a selected book. [Should have]
  RF-017 - Percentage-off promotion creation: The system must allow the store manager to create a promotion with a percentage discount. [Should have]
  RF-018 - Promotion notification: The system must send a promotion notification to all members when the store manager creates a promotion. [Should have]

Requisitos não funcionais:
  RNF-001 (Compatibility) - The system must operate in the two most recent versions of the three most widely used desktop browsers in the target environment. [TBD] | Métrica: 100% of defined functional acceptance tests pass in all six browser-version combinations. [TBD]
  RNF-002 (Performance Efficiency) - The system must respond to catalog searches and standard page requests within 3 seconds at the 95th percentile. [TBD] | Métrica: 95th-percentile response time less than or equal to 3 seconds under 100 concurrent users. [TBD]
  RNF-003 (Reliability) - The system must maintain monthly availability of at least 99%. [TBD] | Métrica: Availability of at least 99% per calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance. [TBD]
  RNF-004 (Maintainability) - The system must provide technical documentation sufficient for a qualified maintainer to deploy the system and modify a documented configuration item within 8 working hours. [TBD] | Métrica: A qualified maintainer completes deployment and one documented configuration change within 8 working hours. [TBD]
  RNF-005 (Interaction Capability) - The system must enable a first-time customer to complete a checkout using a prepared test account and cart within 10 minutes. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 4 of 5 representative test customers complete checkout within 10 minutes without facilitator intervention. [TBD]

Casos de uso:
  UC-001 - Register customer account | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer opens the registration form.
    2. The customer enters the required registration data.
    3. The customer submits the form.
    4. The system validates the data.
    5. The system creates the customer account.
    6. The system confirms account creation.
  UC-002 - Search and add a book to the cart | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer enters a complete book title.
    2. The system searches using an exact-title match.
    3. The system displays matching book records.
    4. The customer selects a book.
    5. The system displays its title, author, and price.
    6. The customer adds the book to the cart.
    7. The system displays the book in the cart with quantity one.
  UC-003 - Complete checkout | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer opens checkout.
    2. The system displays the cart contents.
    3. The customer enters the card number.
    4. The customer submits checkout.
    5. The system records the purchase details.
    6. The system generates a receipt.
    7. The system displays the receipt to the customer.
  UC-004 - Manage catalog and inventory | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The store manager opens the administration area.
    2. The store manager adds a book, edits a price, or views stock.
    3. The system validates the requested operation.
    4. The system stores the change or displays the requested stock quantity.
    5. The system confirms the operation.
  UC-005 - Create promotion and notify members | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The store manager opens promotion management.
    2. The store manager enters the promotion percentage and required details.
    3. The system validates the promotion data.
    4. The system stores the promotion.
    5. The system issues notification requests to all members.
    6. The system confirms promotion creation.

Critérios de aceite:
  CA-001 - Dado The customer has entered all required registration data in valid format., quando The customer submits the registration form., então The system creates one customer account and displays an account-creation confirmation.
  CA-002 - Dado The customer has selected the promotional notification option., quando The customer completes registration., então The account is stored with member status enabled.
  CA-003 - Dado The catalog contains a book titled exactly 'Book A'., quando The customer searches for 'Book A'., então The system returns the record titled 'Book A' and does not return records whose titles only partially match.
  CA-004 - Dado A book exists in the catalog., quando The customer selects the book., então The system displays its title, author, and price.
  CA-005 - Dado The customer is viewing an available book., quando The customer selects the add-to-cart action., então The cart contains the selected book with quantity one.
  CA-006 - Dado The cart already contains one copy of a book., quando The customer attempts to add the same book again., então The cart remains at quantity one and the system displays the one-copy-per-order restriction.
  CA-007 - Dado The customer has a non-empty cart., quando The customer enters a card number and submits checkout., então The system stores the checkout card-number input without invoking a payment processor.
  CA-008 - Dado The authenticated customer is a member and a valid promotion code exists., quando The member enters the code during checkout., então The system applies the configured percentage discount to the checkout total.
  CA-009 - Dado Checkout data has been accepted., quando The system completes checkout., então The system generates one receipt containing the purchased books, buyer, purchase date, and checkout total.
  CA-010 - Dado A checkout has been completed., quando The system finalizes the purchase., então One purchase record is stored with the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date.
  CA-011 - Dado The store manager has valid manager-account credentials., quando The manager submits the login form., então The system authenticates the manager and grants access to the administration area.
  CA-012 - Dado The store manager is authenticated and has entered valid book data., quando The manager submits the new-book form., então The system creates one catalog record for the book.
  CA-013 - Dado A cataloged book exists and the manager has entered a valid new price., quando The manager saves the price change., então The system displays and stores the new price for that book.
  CA-014 - Dado A cataloged book has a current stock quantity., quando The manager opens the inventory view., então The system displays the current stock quantity for the book.
  CA-015 - Dado A book has reached its configured low-stock condition and notification suppression is disabled., quando The low-stock condition is detected., então The system sends one notification request to the manager's configured email address.
  CA-016 - Dado The manager has enabled notification suppression for a book., quando That book reaches its low-stock condition., então The system does not issue a low-stock notification request for the book.
  CA-017 - Dado The manager is authenticated and has entered a valid percentage discount., quando The manager submits the promotion form., então The system stores one active promotion with the configured percentage discount.
  CA-018 - Dado At least one member exists and the manager has created a valid promotion., quando The promotion is saved., então The system issues one notification request for every registered member.

Glossário:
  BECS: Book E-Commerce System, the system specified in this document.
  Customer: A person who creates a regular account and may purchase books through the system.
  Member: A customer who has subscribed to promotional notifications and is eligible to use promotion codes.
  Store Manager: The single person responsible for managing the catalog, prices, inventory, notifications, and promotions.
  Promotion code: A code associated with a percentage-off promotion that may be applied by a member during checkout.
  Low-stock condition: The configured inventory threshold at which the system evaluates whether to notify the store manager.
  Receipt: A record generated after checkout containing purchase details for the customer.
  Checkout: The process in which the customer submits cart contents and card-number information to create a purchase record.

O Documento de Especificação de Requisitos de Software (SRS) é o contrato técnico que descreve o 
que o sistema deve fazer e sob quais condições de qualidade. Ele serve de referência para 
desenvolvedores, testadores, gerentes e clientes durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.
1.1 Artefatos Obrigatórios e sua Ordem
Um SRS completo e formal deve conter os seguintes artefatos, nesta ordem:
• ESCOPO: Define o que está DENTRO e FORA do projeto. Evita scope creep.
• STAKEHOLDERS: Lista todos os envolvidos: quem usa, quem financia, quem é afetado.
• PREMISSAS E RESTRIÇÕES: Fatos assumidos como verdadeiros e limites impostos ao projeto.
• REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO (RN): Políticas, fórmulas e condições de negócio que existem independentemente 
do software.
• REQUISITOS FUNCIONAIS (RF): O que o sistema DEVE FAZER — comportamentos, serviços, respostas a 
entradas.
• REQUISITOS NÃO FUNCIONAIS (RNF): Como o sistema deve SER — atributos de qualidade 
quantificáveis.
• HISTÓRIAS DE USUÁRIO (HU): Necessidades na perspectiva do usuário: Como [perfil], quero [ação], para
[benefício].
• CASOS DE USO (UC): Interações detalhadas ator-sistema com fluxo principal, alternativo e exceções.
• CRITÉRIOS DE ACEITE (CA): Condições testáveis em formato BDD (Dado/Quando/Então) que definem 
quando o requisito está concluído.
• GLOSSÁRIO: Termos do domínio com definição precisa para eliminar ambiguidades.
1.2 Como os Artefatos se Interconectam
Os artefatos formam uma cadeia de rastreabilidade. Cada RF deve ter origem em um STK 
(stakeholder) ou RN. Cada HU deve ter pelo menos um RF associado. Cada RF e HU devem ter pelo menos um CA. Esta rastreabilidade garante que nada seja implementado sem justificativa de 
negócio e que tudo que foi prometido seja testável.
Cadeia de rastreabilidade mínima:
STK → (RN →) RF → HU → CA

A ISO/IEC 25010:2023 define 9 características de qualidade do produto. Todo RNF deve ser 
classificado em uma dessas características. A seguir, cada característica com seus sub-atributos e 
exemplo de RNF.
1. Functional Suitability (Adequação Funcional)
 Functional Completeness — o sistema oferece todas as funções necessárias.
 Functional Correctness — as funções produzem os resultados corretos.
 Functional Appropriateness — as funções facilitam a realização das tarefas.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 1. Functional Suitability
O sistema deve calcular o imposto sobre o valor do pedido aplicando corretamente a alíquota de ICMS 
vigente para o estado de destino, conforme tabela oficial CONFAZ, com variação máxima de R$ 0,01 em 
relação ao valor de referência da Receita Estadual.
2. Performance Efficiency (Eficiência de Desempenho)
 Time Behaviour — tempo de resposta e throughput.
 Resource Utilisation — uso de CPU, memória, rede.
 Capacity — limites máximos suportados.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 2. Performance Efficiency
O sistema deve processar no mínimo 200 pedidos por minuto sob carga de 1.000 usuários simultâneos, com 
tempo de resposta inferior a 2 segundos no percentil 95.
3. Compatibility (Compatibilidade)
 Co-existence — coexiste com outros sistemas sem degradação.
 Interoperability — troca dados com outros sistemas.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 3. Compatibility
A API do sistema deve expor endpoints REST/JSON compatíveis com o padrão OpenAPI 3.0, permitindo 
integração com o ERP legado via OAuth 2.0 sem modificações no ERP.4. Interaction Capability (Capacidade de Interação) — antes 'Usabilidade'

Base: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 §5.2 — Características do requisito individual

SRS described just the differences that the new version should exhibit compared to the previous 
version. Nowhere was there a description of the original system. Consequently, everyone had a 
different understanding of the current system’s capabilities. If you’re in this situation, document

Expected challenges
The presence of an existing system leads to common challenges that both enhancement and 
replacement projects will face, including the following:
■ The changes made could degrade the performance to which users are accustomed.
■ Little or no requirements documentation might be available for the existing system.
■ Users who are familiar with how the system works today might not like the changes they are 
about to encounter.
■ You might unknowingly break or omit functionality that is vital to some stakeholder group.
■ Stakeholders might take this opportunity to request new functionality that seems like a good 
idea but isn’t really needed to meet the business objectives.
Even if there is existing documentation, it might not prove useful. For enhancement projects, 
the documentation might not be up to date. If the documentation doesn’t match the existing 
application’s reality, it is of limited use. For replacement systems, you also need to be wary of carrying 
forward all of the requirements, because some of the old functionality probably should not be 
migrated.
One of the major issues in replacement projects is validating that the reasons for the replacement 
are sound. There need to be justifiable business objectives for the change. When existing systems 
are being completely replaced, organizational processes might also have to change, which makes it 
harder for people to accept a new system. The change in business processes, change in the software 
system, and learning curve of a new system can disrupt current operations.

É Stakeholder ou Ator?
Stakeholder = quem tem interesse no sistema (pode não usá-lo diretamente).
Ator (Caso de Uso) = quem INTERAGE diretamente com o sistema.
Todo Ator é Stakeholder; nem todo Stakeholder é Ator.
É Premissa ou Restrição?
Premissa = fato ASSUMIDO como verdadeiro sem confirmação formal. Pode mudar.
Restrição = limite IMPOSTO que não pode ser negociado (lei, orçamento, prazo, tech).
É escopo IN ou OUT?
IN = funcionalidade que o SISTEMA DO PROJETO vai implementar.
OUT = funcionalidade que fica em outro sistema ou versão futura.

Dois requisitos em uma frase ('e')

'O sistema deve ser rápido e seguro.' → dois RNFs distintos.
AÇÃO: sempre separar em IDs distintos quando há 'e' ligando funcionalidades.
Requisito negativo mal formulado

REFORMULAR como: 'O sistema deve persistir todos os dados de pedido mesmo em caso de falha 
de conexão, retomando a gravação quando a conexão for restabelecida.'

ERRADO: RF-010: 'O sistema tem que ser tipo um CRM mas mais simples.'

1.3 Princípios Fundamentais de Qualidade de Requisitos
Base: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 §5.2 — Características do requisito individual
• Necessário: Existe uma necessidade real que o justifica. Sem o requisito, há uma lacuna de negócio.
• Não ambíguo: Tem uma única interpretação possível. Evitar: 'eficiente', 'fácil', 'rápido', 'amigável'.
• Verificável: Pode ser testado objetivamente com critério mensurável. 'Rápido' não é verificável; '< 2 s' é.
• Singular: Descreve uma única coisa. Nunca usar 'e' ou 'ou' para combinar dois comportamentos em um 
RF.
• Viável: Tecnicamente e financeiramente possível dentro das restrições do projeto.
• Rastreável: Tem origem (stakeholder ou RN) e destino (caso de teste) identificados.
• Completo: Contém todas as informações necessárias para implementação sem consultas adicionais.
• Consistente: Não conflita com nenhum outro requisito do documento.
• Priorizado: Tem um nível de prioridade definido (MoSCoW: Must/Should/Could/Won't).PARTE 2 — Padrões de Escrita por Artefato

atrasados e acima do orçamento.

Elicitação de Requisitos | Syllabus | ©IREB 33 | 43
Um conflito de requisitos pode ser interpretado como um tipo especial de conflito social e é 
definido da seguinte forma: "Um conflito na Engenharia de Requisitos (conflito de requisitos) 
é uma incompatibilidade de requisitos, com base em uma percepção contraditória de dois 
ou mais stakeholders." [RueA2014]. Há vários indicadores pelos quais os conflitos podem ser 
detectados. Os indicadores podem ser observados na comunicação e na documentação.
Os indicadores comumente encontrados na comunicação são:
▪ Negação
▪ Indiferença
▪ Pedantismo
▪ Questões de detalhes
▪ Interpretação incorreta
▪ Ocultação
▪ Delegação
Os indicadores comumente encontrados na documentação são:
▪ Declarações contraditórias dos stakeholders
▪ Resultados conflitantes da análise de documentos ou sistemas
▪ Requisitos inconsistentes em detalhes
▪ Uso inconsistente de termos na especificação
A maioria dos conflitos tende a ser oculta e só pode ser detectada por meio do 
monitoramento cuidadoso desses indicadores. Se um dos indicadores ocorrer, isso não 
significa que haja um conflito de requisitos. No entanto, o Engenheiro de Requisitos deve 
estar sempre atento. Na maioria das atividades de elicitação de requisitos, ele estimula os 
stakeholders a exporem suas posições com clareza, revelando, em alguns casos, problemas 
inesperados ou conflitos existentes.
4.2 Análise de conflitos (L3)
Uma vez identificado um conflito, o Engenheiro de Requisitos deve esclarecer se o conflito 
identificado é ou não um conflito de requisitos. Essa distinção é importante, pois a resolução 
de um conflito de requisitos é a principal responsabilidade do Engenheiro de Requisitos, 
enquanto outros conflitos devem ser resolvidos por outros participantes (p. ex., um gerente 
de projeto).
A análise das características de um conflito de requisitos ajuda o Engenheiro de Requisitos a 
entender sua natureza. As seguintes características [RueA2014] de um conflito podem 
ajudar a entender sua natureza e a encontrar uma solução adequada:
▪ Tipo de conflito
▪ Assunto do conflito
▪ Requisitos afetados
▪ Stakeholders envolvidos
▪ Opiniões das diversos stakeholders

▪ Parafrasear requisitos textuais representados de forma a melhorar a sua 
compreensibilidade, em particular no que diz respeito às relações entre eles.
▪ Validar requisitos representados textualmente com o objetivo de descobrir omissões, 
ambiguidades e inconsistências.
As linguagens de modelagem são usadas para expressar modelos. Várias linguagens de 
modelagem, por exemplo, UML [OMG2017] ou BPMN [OMG2013], foram padronizadas. 
Quando requisitos são especificados em uma linguagem de modelagem não-padrão, é 
necessária uma menção que explique a sintaxe e a semântica da linguagem de modelagem 
utilizada.
Há muitos tipos de modelos que podem ser usados na ER. Um engenheiro de requisitos deve 
entender qual o tipo de modelo mais adequado para especificar os requisitos em uma 
determinada situação.
Em uma fase inicial, o Engenheiro de Requisitos frequentemente começa com a modelagem 
do contexto (3.4.2) ou dos objetivos do sistema pretendido.
3.4.2 Modelagem de contexto (L2)
Os modelos que focam o aspecto do contexto especificam a incorporação estrutural de um 
sistema em seu ambiente e a interação entre um sistema e os atores no contexto do 
sistema.
Modelos de contexto especificam um sistema e os atores no contexto do sistema que 
interagem com o sistema. Um modelo de contexto também esboça as interfaces entre um 
sistema e seu contexto (p. ex., em termos de quais informações são trocadas).
Diagramas de contexto são usados como linguagem de modelagem gráfica para expressar 
modelos de contexto.Não existe uma notação padronizada para os diagramas de contexto. 
Diagramas de contexto de análise estruturada [DeMa1978] ou diagramas de caixa e linha 
sob medida [Glin2019] podem ser usados para expressar modelos de contexto.
Na linguagem de modelagem UML [OMG2017], os diagramas de casos de uso fornecem um 
meio para modelar um sistema e seu contexto em termos de casos de uso do sistema e os 
atores no contexto do sistema que interagem com o sistema através desses casos de uso.
Casos de Uso modelam a interação dinâmica entre um ator no contexto do sistema e um 
sistema a partir da perspectiva do ator. Os casos de uso são na sua maioria escritos usando 
templates de formulários em linguagem natural (3.3) ou usando diagramas de atividade UML 
(3.4.4).
3.4.3 Modelagem de estruturas e dados (L3)
Os modelos que se concentram em aspectos de estrutura e dados especificam os requisitos 
de propriedades estruturais estáticas de um sistema ou de um domínio.
Os modelos de domínio estático especificam os objetos (de negócios) e suas relações em 
um domínio de interesse. Eles podem ser expressos com diagramas [OMG2017] de classes 
UML.

- Any visitor can create an account with no verification process.
- Logged-in users can search for books by title only, with an exact match (no partial matches, no search by author).

- Only one copy of each book can be purchased per order.
- Members (a subset of registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
- The manager (a single login-based account) can add books, edit prices, and view stock levels.
- The system must automatically notify the manager by email when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that specific book.
- The manager can create percentage-off promotions; creating one automatically emails all members.
- The system does not process real credit card payments; it only collects a card number, produces a receipt, and logs the purchase (item, buyer, timestamp).
- Encryption and password recovery are explicitly out of scope for this version.
- There is only one manager account; no multi-manager roles are needed.
- A manager account must never also be a regular customer account.
- The system must run as a normal browser-accessible web application, with no exotic technical requirements.

em_escopo: Account creation for any visitor, with no verification process
Book search by exact title match (logged-in users)
Viewing book title, author, and price
Shopping cart with a limit of one copy per book per order
Checkout flow that collects a card number, generates a receipt, and logs the purchase
Member signup to receive promotion notifications and use promo codes at checkout
Manager login to manage inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock)
Automatic low-stock email alert to the manager, with per-book opt-out
Manager-created percentage-off promotions with automatic email to all members
fora_de_escopo: Real credit card / payment processing — deferred to a later phase
Encryption — not a priority for this version
Password recovery — not a priority for this version
Multiple manager accounts or manager roles — only one manager
Partial/fuzzy search or search by author — title search is exact-match only
Multiple copies of the same book per order — limited to one
premissas: PA-01: Only one person will operate the manager account for the store.
restricoes: REST-01 (Tecnica): The system must be usable through a normal web browser, with no exotic client-side requirements.

stakeholders.descricao: Store Manager — the single account responsible for managing inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock) and creating promotions; must never also be a regular customer account.
Visitor — anyone arriving at the site who can create an account with no verification process.
Registered User / Customer — logged-in user who can search for books, add them to a cart, and check out.
Member — a registered user who opted in to promotion notifications; the only type of user who can apply promo codes at checkout.

regras_de_negocio.descricao: A cart may contain at most one copy of each distinct book per order.
A manager account must never also function as a regular customer account.
Only members (not all registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
The low-stock email alert to the manager is suppressed for a given book if the manager has disabled notifications for that specific book.
Creating a new percentage-off promotion automatically triggers an email to all members.

requisitos_funcionais.descricao: The system must allow any visitor to create an account with no verification process.
The system must allow logged-in users to search for books by title using an exact match only (no partial match, no search by author).
The system must display each book's title, author, and price.
The system must allow users to add a book to their shopping cart.
The system must prevent a user from adding more than one copy of the same book to their cart in a single order.
The system must allow users to complete checkout for the items in their cart.
The system must allow a registered user to sign up as a member to receive promotion notifications.
The system must allow members to apply a promo code during checkout.
The system must provide a login for the manager, separate from customer accounts.
The system must allow the manager to add new books to the inventory.
The system must allow the manager to edit the price of existing books.
The system must allow the manager to view current stock levels.
The system must send an email notification to the manager when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that book.
The system must allow the manager to create percentage-off promotions.
The system must automatically email all members when a new promotion is created.
The system must collect a card number during checkout without processing an actual payment.
The system must generate a receipt after checkout.
The system must log each purchase, including the item, the buyer, and the timestamp.

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: The system must be usable through a standard web browser, with no exotic or non-standard client-side requirements.

historias_de_usuario.descricao: As a visitor, I want to create an account with no verification process, so that I can start using the site quickly.
As a registered user, I want to search for a book by its exact title, so that I can find the book I'm looking for.
As a registered user, I want to view a book's title, author, and price, so that I can decide whether to buy it.
As a registered user, I want to add a book to my cart, so that I can purchase it later.
As a registered user, I want to check out my cart, so that I can complete my purchase.
As a member, I want to apply a promo code at checkout, so that I can get a discount.
As the manager, I want to add new books and edit their prices, so that I can keep the catalog up to date.
As the manager, I want to be notified when a book's stock is low, so that I can restock in time.
As the manager, I want to create percentage-off promotions, so that I can attract more sales.
As a member, I want to receive an email when a new promotion is created, so that I know about current deals.

casos_de_uso.descricao: Search and Purchase Book — a logged-in user searches for a book by exact title, adds it to the cart, and completes checkout.
Manage Inventory — the manager logs in and adds new books, edits prices, or views current stock levels.
Create Promotion — the manager creates a percentage-off promotion, and the system automatically emails all members.

criterios_de_aceite.descricao: Given a logged-in user, when they search for a book title that exactly matches an existing book, then the system returns that book with its title, author, and price.
Given a user already has one copy of a book in their cart, when they try to add another copy of the same book, then the system prevents the second copy from being added.
Given a member is at checkout with a valid promo code, when they apply the code, then the system applies the corresponding discount.
Given a book's stock drops below the defined threshold and notifications are enabled for that book, when the stock update occurs, then the system sends an email to the manager.
Given the manager creates a new percentage-off promotion, when the promotion is saved, then the system automatically sends an email to all members.
